info.name: CampusStay API
info.description:
Automated API tests for the CampusStay JSON API.

1. Start the app (python manage.py init, then python manage.py run).
2. Set the baseUrl collection variable if your port is not 5000.
3. Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner) - later requests reuse tokens and ids saved by earlier ones.

Needs the seeded accounts bob/bobpass (tenant), alice/alicepass and admin/adminpass (landlords).

exec: pm.test("Error says username or email already exists", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.include("already exists"));
pm.test("Property belongs to the landlord and is available", () => { pm.expect(p.available).to.eql(true); pm.expect(p.owner_id).to.be.a("number"); });

exec: pm.test("Newly created property is listed", () => pm.expect(list.map(p => p.id)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("propertyId"))));
pm.test("Each listing has the expected fields", () => list.forEach(p => pm.expect(p).to.include.keys("id","title","location","price_per_night","owner_id","available")));
pm.test("Only the matching property is returned", () => { pm.expect(list).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(list[0].location).to.include("Postman Test Street"); });

exec: pm.test("Includes the seeded accounts", () => pm.expect(users.map(u => u.username)).to.include.members(["bob", "alice"]));
